#  Study1 behavior analysis
```{r load data}
Study1.dt_interval = read_csv("C:/Users/ruirui/Desktop/文章3/Study1/dt_interval_m3.csv") 
Study1.dt_interval$gender = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$gender)
Study1.dt_interval$FeedPrev = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$FeedPrev)
Study1.dt_interval$SocialPrev = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$SocialPrev)
Study1.dt_interval$DiffPrev = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$DiffPrev)
Study1.dt_interval$Social = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$Social)
Study1.dt_interval$Difference = as.factor(Study1.dt_interval$Difference)
Study1.dt_interval$meanCongruency = as.numeric(Study1.dt_interval$meanCongruency)

Study1_check = read_csv("C:/Users/ruirui/Desktop/文章3/Study1/post_rate.csv") 
```


```{r Study1 behavior data}
### CRPS ###
Study1.dt_interval_CRPS = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SubID, SocialPrev, DiffPrev) %>%
  filter(CRPS > mean(CRPS) - 3 * sd(CRPS),
         CRPS < mean(CRPS) + 3 * sd(CRPS)) 

### RT ###
Study1.dt_interval_RT = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SubID, SocialPrev, DiffPrev) %>%
  filter(meanRT > mean(meanRT) - 3 * sd(meanRT),
         meanRT < mean(meanRT) + 3 * sd(meanRT))

### InConRT ###
Study1.dt_interval_InConRT = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SubID, SocialPrev, DiffPrev) %>%
  filter(InConMeanRT > mean(InConMeanRT) - 3 * sd(InConMeanRT),
         InConMeanRT < mean(InConMeanRT) + 3 * sd(InConMeanRT))

### Demographic variables ###
Study1_age = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::summarise(age_mean = round(mean(age),3),
                   age_sd = round(sd(age),3))
Study1_age

Study1_gender = Study1.dt_interval %>%
 dplyr::group_by(SubID,gender)%>%
 nest()%>%
 group_by(gender)%>%
 dplyr::summarise(category_counts = n()) 

Study1_gender
```

```{r Study1 des}
Study1_ACC.feedback = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::group_by(DiffPrev,SocialPrev) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ACC_mean = round(mean(ACC),3),
                   ACC_sd = round(sd(ACC),3),
                   ACC_se = ACC_sd/sqrt(35))
Study1_ACC.feedback

##
Study1_feedback_sub = Study1.dt_interval %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SubID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(counts = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

Study1_feedback_count = Study1_feedback_sub %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Difference, Social) %>%
  mutate(Social = factor(recode(Social,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                         levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  mutate(Difference = factor(recode(Difference, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                             levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(feed_mean = round(mean(counts),3),
                   feed_sd = round(sd(counts),3),
                   feed_se=feed_sd/sqrt(35)) 
Study1_feedback_count
```

## Study1 post rating check
### Study1 emotion post rating
```{r Study1 emotion post rating des} 
Study1_check_emotion_sub = Study1_check %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = emotion1:emotion5,
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "emotion"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = dplyr::recode(
      condition,
      emotion1 = "Large downward",
      emotion2 = "Small downward",
      emotion3 = "Large upward",
      emotion4 = "Small upward",
      emotion5 = "Lateral"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(emotion, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(emotion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c(
        "Large downward",
        "Small downward",
        "Lateral",
        "Small upward",
        "Large upward"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(condition) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean = round(mean, 3),
    sd = round(sd, 3)
  )

Study1_check_emotion_sub
```

```{r Study1 emotion post rating aov}
Study1_check_emotion = Study1_check %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("emotion"),
               names_to = "cond",
               values_to = "emotion") %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond,
                       levels = c("emotion1","emotion2","emotion5","emotion4","emotion3"),
                       labels = c("Large_downward","Small_downward","Lateral",
                                  "Small_upward","Large_upward")))

Study1_check_emotion_aov = aov_ez(id = "SubID", dv = "emotion", 
                            within = "cond", data = Study1_check_emotion)
Study1_check_emotion_aov

Study1_check_emotion_post = pairs(emmeans(Study1_check_emotion_aov, ~ cond), 
                                adjust = "bonferroni")
Study1_check_emotion_post

```


```{r Study1 emotion post rating emmeans}
emotion_emm = emmeans(
  Study1_check_emotion_aov,
  ~ cond
)

emotion_linear = contrast(
  emotion_emm,
  method = list(
    "Linear trend" = c(2, 1, 0, -1, -2)
  ),
  adjust = "none"
)

emotion_linear
```
##  Study1 CRPS analysis
### Study1 social feedback CRPS
```{r Study1 social feedback CRPS lmm}
### linear mixed-effects model CRPS
Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm = Study1.dt_interval_CRPS %>%
  dplyr::filter(SocialPrev == "1"|SocialPrev == "2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  mutate(meanCongruency = as.numeric(meanCongruency)) %>%
  mutate(gender = factor(gender))

contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$SocialPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$DiffPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$gender) = contr.sum

Study1.lmm_CRPS = lmerTest::lmer(CRPS ~ age+gender+SocialPrev*DiffPrev+meanCongruency+
                               (1+SocialPrev*DiffPrev+meanCongruency|SubID), Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm, REML=FALSE)

summary(Study1.lmm_CRPS)
Study1.lmm_CRPS_anova = anova(Study1.lmm_CRPS)
Study1.lmm_CRPS_anova 

```

```{r Study1 social comparison CRPS ci}
Study1.lmm_CRPS_ci = model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_CRPS,
  standardize = NULL,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  ci = 0.95,
  effects = "all",
  summary = getOption("parameters_mixed_summary", FALSE),
  digits = 3)

Study1.lmm_CRPS_ci
```


```{r Study1 social feedback CRPS des}
Study1_CRPS.feedback = Study1.dt_interval_CRPS %>%
  dplyr::group_by(DiffPrev,SocialPrev) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CRPS_mean = round(mean(CRPS),3),
                   CRPS_sd = round(sd(CRPS),3),
                   CRPS_se = CRPS_sd/sqrt(35))
Study1_CRPS.feedback
```

```{r Study1 social feedback CRPS post hoc}
lmm_CRPS_post_hoc1 = summary(emmeans(Study1.lmm_CRPS, 
                                     list(pairwise~ DiffPrev|SocialPrev),
                                     adjust = "bonferroni",
                                     pbkrtest.limit = 10000))
summary(lmm_CRPS_post_hoc1)

lmm_CRPS_post_hoc2 = summary(emmeans(Study1.lmm_CRPS, 
                                     list(pairwise~ SocialPrev|DiffPrev), 
                                     adjust = "bonferroni",
                                     pbkrtest.limit = 10000))
summary(lmm_CRPS_post_hoc2)
```

```{r Study1 social feedback CRPS plot}
Study1_CRPS.sub = Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SubID, SocialPrev, DiffPrev) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CRPS_mean = round(mean(CRPS),3),
                   CRPS_sd = round(sd(CRPS),3),
                   CRPS_se=CRPS_sd/sqrt(35))

Study1_CRPS = Study1_CRPS.sub %>%  
  dplyr::mutate(Social = factor(recode(SocialPrev, "1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"), 
                                levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Diff = factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"), 
                              levels = c("Large", "Small")))


Study1_CRPS.plot = ggbarplot(Study1_CRPS, x = "Diff", y = "CRPS_mean", 
                           fill = "Social", alpha = 0.7,
                           ylab = "CRPS", xlab = "Difference",
                           add.params = list(color = "Social"),
                           add = c("mean_se","jitter"),
                           palette = c("#1b7c3d", "#2b6a99"), 
                           width = 0.45,
                           position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.8, 1.3)) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20))

Study1_CRPS.plot = ggpar(Study1_CRPS.plot, legend = 'right') +
  labs(fill = "Social Comparison") +  
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

Study1_CRPS.plot

```


### Study1 model effort estimate CRPS
```{r Study1 effort estimate CRPS lmm}
### linear mixed-effects model CRPS
Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm = Study1.dt_interval_CRPS %>%
  dplyr::filter(SocialPrev == "1"|SocialPrev == "2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  mutate(meanCongruency = as.numeric(meanCongruency)) %>%
  mutate(gender = factor(gender))

contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$SocialPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$DiffPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm$gender) = contr.sum

Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS = lmerTest::lmer(CRPS ~ age+gender+mbased_effort_pre_m3+meanCongruency+
                               (1+mbased_effort_pre_m3+meanCongruency|SubID), 
                               Study1.dt_CRPS_lmm, REML=FALSE)

summary(Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS)
Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS_anova = anova(Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS)
Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS_anova 
##integrated_PC1  discrepancy_PC2  mbased_effort_pre_m3  mbased_efficacy_pre_m3 
```



```{r Study1 effort estimate CRPS ci}
Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS_ci = model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS,
  standardize = NULL,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  ci = 0.95,
  effects = "all",
  summary = getOption("parameters_mixed_summary", FALSE),
  digits = 3)

Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS_ci
```

```{r all model CRPS}
## Effort intention
effort_sep = parameters::model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_effort_CRPS,
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  effects = "fixed") %>%
  filter(Parameter == "mbased_effort_pre_m3") %>%
  transmute(Predictor = "Effort intention",
            Model = "Separate model",
            b = Coefficient,
            CI_low = CI_low,
            CI_high = CI_high,
            p = p)

## Efficacy expectation
efficacy_sep = parameters::model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_efficacy_CRPS,

            Model = "Separate model",

            CI_low = CI_low,
            CI_high = CI_high,
            p = p)

effort_joint = parameters::model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_combined_CRPS,
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  effects = "fixed") %>%
  
  filter(Parameter == "mbased_effort_pre_m3") %>%
  transmute(Predictor = "Effort intention",
            Model = "Joint model",
            b = Coefficient,
            CI_low = CI_low,

            p = p)

## Efficacy expectation：joint
efficacy_joint = parameters::model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_combined_CRPS,
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  effects = "fixed") %>%
  filter(Parameter == "mbased_efficacy_pre_m3") %>%
  transmute(Predictor = "Efficacy expectation",
            Model = "Joint model",
            b = Coefficient,
            CI_low = CI_low,
            CI_high = CI_high,
            p = p)

plot_CRPS = bind_rows(
  effort_sep,
  efficacy_sep,

plot_CRPS
```

```{r all model CRPS}
plot_CRPS$Predictor = factor(plot_CRPS$Predictor,
                             levels = c("Efficacy expectation",
                                        "Effort intention"))

plot_CRPS$Model = factor(plot_CRPS$Model,
                         levels = c("Joint model",
                                    "Separate model"))

model_CRPS.plot = ggplot(plot_CRPS,
  aes(x = b,
      y = Predictor,
      shape = Model,
      color = Model )) +

  geom_vline( xintercept = 0,
              color = "grey60",
              linewidth = 0.7) +

  # 95% CI
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low,
                     xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0,
                 linewidth = 0.8,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)) +

  # coefficient
  geom_point(size = 3.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Separate model" = "#D97973",
    "Joint model" = "#47A6A0" )) +
  
  labs(x = "Regression coefficient (b)",
      y = NULL, shape = NULL, color = NULL) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "bottom")+gg.side

model_CRPS.plot
#ggsave("...Study1_model3_CRPS.pdf",model_CRPS.plot, width = 5.5, height = 6)
```

##  Study1 RT analysis
### Study1 social feedback RT
```{r Study1 social feedback RT lmm}
### linear mixed-effects model RT
Study1.dt_RT_lmm = Study1.dt_interval_RT %>%
  dplyr::filter(SocialPrev == "1"|SocialPrev == "2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  mutate(meanCongruency = as.numeric(meanCongruency)) %>%
  mutate(gender = factor(gender)) %>%
  mutate(logRT = log(meanRT))

contrasts(Study1.dt_RT_lmm$SocialPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_RT_lmm$DiffPrev) = contr.sum
contrasts(Study1.dt_RT_lmm$gender) = contr.sum

Study1.lmm_RT = lmerTest::lmer(meanRT ~ age+gender+SocialPrev*DiffPrev+meanCongruency+
                               (1+SocialPrev*DiffPrev+meanCongruency|SubID), 
                               Study1.dt_RT_lmm, REML=FALSE)
 
summary(Study1.lmm_RT)
Study1.lmm_RT_anova = anova(Study1.lmm_RT)
Study1.lmm_RT_anova
```

```{r Study1 social feedback social comparison RT ci}
Study1.lmm_RT_ci = model_parameters(
  Study1.lmm_RT,
  standardize = NULL,
  ci_method = "satterthwaite",
  ci = 0.95,
  effects = "all",
  summary = getOption("parameters_mixed_summary", FALSE),
  digits = 3)

Study1.lmm_RT_ci
```

```{r Study1 RT des}
Study1_RT.feedback = Study1.dt_interval_RT %>%
  dplyr::group_by(DiffPrev,SocialPrev) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SocialPrev = factor(recode(SocialPrev,"1" = "Downward", "2" = "Upward"),
                                    levels = c("Downward", "Upward"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DiffPrev= factor(recode(DiffPrev, "1" = "Large", "2" = "Small"),
                                 levels = c("Large", "Small"))) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(RT_mean = round(mean(meanRT)),
                   RT_sd = round(sd(meanRT)),
                   RT_se = RT_sd/sqrt(35))
```

```{r all model RewP}
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  # 95% CI
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low,
                     xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0,
                 linewidth = 0.8,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)) +
  
  # coefficient
  geom_point(size = 3.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)) +

  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Separate model" = "#D97973",
      "Joint model" = "#47A6A0"))+
  
  labs(x = "Regression coefficient (b)",
       y = NULL,
       shape = NULL,
       color = NULL) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "bottom")+gg.side
```

```{r all model P3}
  labs(x = "Regression coefficient (b)",

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
```

## Study1 HDDM
### Study1 feedback hddm
```{r Study1 feedback hddm trace}
Study1_feedback.hddm = read.csv("C:/Users/ruirui/Desktop/文章3/Study1/Study1_feedback_diff_traces.csv")

Study1_feedback.traces = Study1_feedback.hddm %>%
  dplyr::select( v_Intercept,
                 v_comparison.T.downward.,
                 v_difference.T.large.,
                 v_comparison.T.downward..difference.T.large.,
                 a_Intercept,
                 a_comparison.T.downward.,
                 a_difference.T.large.,
                 a_comparison.T.downward..difference.T.large. ) %>%
  
  dplyr::rename(v_feed = v_comparison.T.downward.,
                v_diff = v_difference.T.large.,
                v_interaction = v_comparison.T.downward..difference.T.large.,
                a_feed = a_comparison.T.downward.,
                a_diff = a_difference.T.large.,
                a_interaction = a_comparison.T.downward..difference.T.large.) %>%
  
  dplyr::mutate(v_feed_main = v_feed + 0.5 * v_interaction,
                v_diff_main = v_diff + 0.5 * v_interaction,
                v_DownUp_small = v_feed,
                v_DownUp_large = v_feed + v_interaction,
                v_LargeSmall_upward = v_diff,
                v_LargeSmall_downward = v_diff + v_interaction,
    
                a_feed_main = a_feed + 0.5 * a_interaction,
                a_diff_main = a_diff + 0.5 * a_interaction,
                a_DownUp_small = a_feed,
                a_DownUp_large = a_feed + a_interaction,
                a_LargeSmall_upward = a_diff,
                a_LargeSmall_downward = a_diff + a_interaction)
```



```{r Study1 feedback hddm drift rate test}
## Add the posterior probabilities
# Drift rate
# Feed_main: Down - Up
# Diff_main:  Large - Small
# Interaction: (Down - Up)Large - (Down - Up)Small
# v_DownUp_easy: Down - Up | Small
# v_DownUp_hard: Down - Up | Large
# v_HardEasy_upward: Large - Small | Upward
# v_HardEasy_downward: Large - Small | Downward

drift.tests = c(
  "v_feed_main > 0",
  "v_diff_main < 0",
  "v_interaction > 0",
  "v_DownUp_small > 0",
  "v_DownUp_large > 0")

drift.hypotheses = lapply(
  drift.tests,
  function(x) hypothesis(Study1_feedback.traces, x))

names(drift.hypotheses) = drift.tests

Study1_feedback.results.drift = data.frame(
  test = drift.tests,
  Post.Prob = unname(sapply(drift.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$Post.Prob)),
  estimate = unname(sapply(drift.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$Estimate)),
  ci.lower = unname(sapply(drift.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$CI.Lower)),
  ci.upper = unname(sapply(drift.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$CI.Upper)))

Study1_feedback.results.drift
```


```{r Study1 feedback hddm threshold test}
## Add the posterior probabilities
# Threshold
# Feed_main: Down - Up
# Diff_main:  Large - Small
# Interaction: (Down - Up)Large - (Down - Up)Small
# v_DownUp_easy: Down - Up | Small
# v_DownUp_hard: Down - Up | Large
th.tests = c(
  "a_feed_main < 0",
  "a_diff_main < 0",
  "a_interaction < 0",
  "a_DownUp_small > 0",
  "a_DownUp_large < 0")

th.hypotheses = lapply(
  th.tests,
  function(x) hypothesis(Study1_feedback.traces, x))

Study1_feedback.results.th = data.frame(
  test = th.tests,
  Post.Prob = unname(sapply(th.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$Post.Prob)),
  estimate = unname(sapply(th.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$Estimate)),
  ci.lower = unname(sapply(th.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$CI.Lower)),
  ci.upper = unname(sapply(th.hypotheses, function(x) x$hypothesis$CI.Upper)))

Study1_feedback.results.th
```

```{r Study1 effort and efficacy hddm}
Study1_combined.hddm = read.csv("C:/Users/ruirui/Desktop/文章3/Study1/Study1_combined_cong_traces.csv")
```

```{r Study1 effort and efficacy hddm drift plot}
  labs( x = "Effect on drift rate",
        y = "Posterior density",
        fill = NULL,

  theme(legend.position = "top")+gg.side
```
